summary: On a coordinate plane, two rectangles have sides parallel to the axes. Each rectangle is identified by the coordinates of its lower left corner and its upper right corner. Read those coordinates and write the area covered by the two rectangles together. Count an overlapping region only once, never twice. When they do not overlap, add the two separate areas. The result always fits in a signed 32 bit integer.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
